resources.string: Explore by period
Choose a period to explore its events.
Browse periods
Events are listed alphabetically within each period.
Origins
Creation, rupture, preservation and scattering in the opening chapters of Genesis.
The patriarchs
The promise follows a family, from Abraham to the arrival in Egypt.
Exodus and wilderness
Deliverance, covenant and the formation of a people during the journey.
The land and the judges
Entry into the land, crises of faithfulness and different forms of leadership.
The rise of the monarchy
Saul, David and Solomon: leadership, promises and the limits of power.
Kingdoms and prophets
Divided kingdoms, prophetic messages and the path through Samaria’s fall.
Crisis and exile
Jerusalem’s fall, life in exile, lament and hope. Readings grouped by context, without an exact order between books.
Return and rebuilding
Life under Persian rule, return and the renewal of the community.
The life of Jesus
A reading of the Gospels, from the announcement of the birth to the resurrection. Episode order varies between accounts.
The church in Acts
From witness in Jerusalem to missionary journeys and the arrival in Rome.
